_doc: Round scaling. Formulas implemented in autoload/round_manager.gd; tests in tests/unit/test_round_scaling.gd.

egg_mode._doc: T-181 Easter Egg Mode (EggMode, GLSettings egg_mode off / sparse / none; test_egg_mode.gd). sparse: count.base crawlers a round, +1 every count.per_rounds, at most count.max (never more than the normal count); the round ends when they die or after round_max_s. none: no queue, a round lasts round_s. Either: crawlers only, health of round min(round, health_round_cap); while a hold runs at most hold_active[mode] crawlers up; while a kill-count step is open (feed_step_types) at most feed_active, spawned every feed_interval_s. No Bellringer rounds, scheduled Foreman, Screamer, Glasshide or homage boss rounds. Normal mode never reads this block.

speed_tiers._doc: Percent of Ganger spawns per tier (docs/ENEMIES.md 1.5). Max 3 sprinters back-to-back.

stranded._doc: UPDATE 07 QA (T-107): a round that cannot end. When nothing is left to spawn and a chasing zombie's path end has stayed farther than far_m from every living player for `seconds` (the players went somewhere its path never reaches: a crawler jammed at a doorway on Kaltenbrunn held round 12 for 140 minutes), the director relocates it to an active ground spawn near the players. Checked every check_every_s. Any map, any act.

milestones._doc: Guaranteed rewards on reaching a round (T-078): "R": [power-up ids]. They drop when round R-1's last zombie dies, a step ahead of the nearest standing player toward that kill (on the navmesh), last milestone.lifetime_seconds (powerups.json) and are applied anyway if nobody picks them up. Once per match each. A campaign arrival past R skips it.

_doc_retained: retained_health_mult: Map 4 Act IV's Retained state (the renewal ending, T-113): zombie health x this for the rest of the match.

map_overrides._doc: UPDATE 10 (C2, T-153): per-map spawn pressure, keyed by the map id's first part. spawn_interval_mult scales RoundManager.current_interval, max_active_add raises max_active. Totenhafen paid the least Scrip per round (THE_BAR); the soak before/after is in DECISIONS T-153.
